speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (specifically 17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency). The combination of ambiguous genitalia (partial labial fusion, clitoromegaly) at birth, hypertension-related features (suggested by maternal hypertrichosis and patient's severe acne), and delayed puberty in a 16-year-old female is highly characteristic of this condition, which disrupts both mineralocorticoid and androgen production.
